title: Charlemagne and the tyrants of the air

tellings.quote: It was so prominent that hysteria broke out about it in the French court and Charlemagne was considering declaring war on the tyrants of the air.

plain: In the time of Charlemagne, the medieval king of the Franks, sightings of craft in the sky over France were said to be so common that panic broke out at the French court, and Charlemagne considered declaring war on these "tyrants of the air." The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this on the show, drawing on the book The Gods of Eden by William Bramley. If true, people were seeing and fearing unknown things in the sky more than a thousand years ago.
